name: Aditya Hridayam: opening verse
text:
आदित्यहृदयं पुण्यं सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम् ।
जयावहं जपेन्नित्यमक्षय्यं परमं शिवम् ॥
meaning: The Aditya Hridayam is praised as a sacred hymn associated with victory, strength and the removal of inner and outer obstacles.
purpose: A solar hymn from the Ramayana tradition, recited for courage and renewed strength.
supports: Confidence; persistence; facing challenges; reconnecting with vitality.
when: In the morning, or before a demanding undertaking.
note: The client list contains a corrupted short version, under Saturday. This is a commonly circulated opening verse; consult a complete reliable edition for the full Aditya Hridayam.
